# Domain reference: Legal

Job family covered: Corporate Counsel (generalist, specialist), Legal Manager, General Counsel / Legal Director, Compliance Officer, DPO.

---

## Core competencies (x3)

| Competency | Junior / Legal Counsel | Experienced / Senior Legal Counsel | Senior / Legal Manager | Leadership / General Counsel (DJ) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Technical legal expertise | Drafts and reviews standard contracts. Carries out legal research. | Negotiates complex contracts, handles litigation, produces risk analyses. | Supervises legal output, arbitrates risks, structures the contracting policy. | Defines the legal strategy, handles major risks, engages with outside counsel and regulators. |
| Advice to operational teams | Answers routine legal questions under supervision. | Advises teams autonomously, anticipates risks, proposes pragmatic solutions. | Integrates legal into business decisions, trains teams, creates decision-support tools. | Advises the CODIR (comité de direction, executive committee) and the board, anticipates regulatory changes, leads legal transformation. |
| Compliance & regulation | Applies compliance procedures. Knows the GDPR (RGPD) and the regulatory basics of the sector. | Leads compliance audits, sets up procedures, handles incidents. | Defines the compliance policy, structures programs, manages relations with the authorities. | Carries compliance at the strategic level, anticipates regulations, influences industry standards. |

## Secondary competencies (x2)

| Competency | Description by level |
|---|---|
| Contract negotiation | Junior: assists negotiations. Experienced: negotiates face-to-face. Senior: leads strategic negotiations. Leadership: arbitrates structuring deals. |
| Litigation management | Junior: assembles case files. Experienced: handles routine litigation with outside counsel. Senior: leads the litigation strategy. Leadership: handles major disputes, arbitrates settlements. |

## Complementary competencies (x1)

| Competency | Description |
|---|---|
| Employment law (droit social) | Employment contracts, disciplinary matters, collective labor relations (in synergy with HR leadership, DRH). |
| Intellectual property | Patents, trademarks, copyright, software licenses. |
| Corporate law | Capital transactions, governance, general meetings (AG), mergers and acquisitions. |
| Tools & legaltech | CLM (contract lifecycle management), legal monitoring tools, databases. |

---

## Recommended role-play scenarios

- **Contractual risk analysis**: present a commercial contract with 3-4 problematic clauses. Ask the candidate to identify the risks, propose alternatives and prioritize the negotiation points. Observe: analytical rigor, pragmatism (not blocking everything), ability to communicate risk in business terms.
- **Urgent internal advice**: a salesperson wants to sign a deal tomorrow, and the contract contains non-standard clauses. The candidate must balance business urgency and legal protection. Observe: ability to prioritize, to say no constructively, to propose quick solutions.

## Red flags

### Red
- Legal answers with no nuance (everything is forbidden or everything is allowed)
- Unable to explain a legal concept in plain terms to a non-lawyer
- No reference to risk management (binary legal/illegal reasoning)

### Orange
- Exclusive focus on legal technique with no business consideration
- Difficulty working under urgency or prioritizing
- "Guardian of the temple" stance with no pragmatism
